competitiveTarget: Resort / master-planned community detail page (e.g. Tetherow). Beats Zillow/Redfin community pages by pairing live verified market data with authored local knowledge (sub-neighborhoods, HOA + club dues, amenities, drive times), a split-scroll map/ledger spine, scrubbable price history, and an inline payment slider.
note: Geo archetype v3.1 (Experience System de-tiling pass, 2026-06-09). ListingLedger replaces uniform ListingCard grid (1 dominant featured + hairline ledger rows). CommunityMapLedgerPane provides split-scroll spine (map sticky right desktop, ledger scrolls left). LiveMarketBand v2: one giant Amboqia activeCount + quiet aux stats, overlaps hero by 3rem. PriceHistoryScrubber adds scrubbable recharts price history. PaymentSlider adds inline mortgage estimate. useCountUp wired to hero + band activeCount stats. All SEO output (MetadataBlock: breadcrumb + Place + Dataset + FAQPage) and data accuracy (CLAUDE.md §0) preserved. SiteHeader/SiteFooter render from app/layout.tsx.
